description: Hear about the history of Soho on a walk around some of the sites associated with colourful characters yesteryear. From Soho's beginnings as a fashionable suburb in the seventeenth century up to the 1950s, I regale you with delicious snippets of history. We end the tour with the option of refreshments at the birthplace of British Rock n Roll.

factsheet.heading: A Social History of East Soho
paragraphs:
Hear about the development of Soho, when it was laid out on fields during the reign of the 'Merry Monarch'. From Soho Square, we explore the narrow streets of the area, stopping to contemplate the locations of some iconic events in Britain's history: Peter Cook's ground-breaking comedy club; the shooting of the symbolic image of the 1960s; the birthplace of British RocknRoll. See the drinking spots frequented by some of the movers and shakers of the 20th century, the residence of an impoverished Karl Marx and more. Peppered with amusing anecdotes, we'll explore Soho's fascinating history as a place where people could throw off society's restrictions.
Comfortable footwear and a drink required.
